message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel horizontal bar chart comparing SpreadsheetBench-Vrf scores for Gemma-4 and GPT-5.5 users across baseline and trace-derived skills.","description":"The target is a two-panel horizontal bar chart. The legend maps gray to No trace, purple to Qwen traces, blue to Gemma-4 traces, and green to GPT-5.5 traces. The left panel is labeled “Gemma-4 user”: No Skill (gray, No trace) scores 41.2; Human-Written (gray, No trace) 37.7; 122B Deepen +Comb. (purple, Qwen traces) 55.5; 35B Deepen +Comb. (purple, Qwen traces) 43.8; Self Deepen +Err. (blue, Gemma-4 traces) 60.5; and Self Deepen +Comb. (blue, Gemma-4 traces) 47.2. The right panel is labeled “GPT-5.5 user”: No Skill (gray, No trace) scores 32.5; Human-Written (gray, No trace) 52.0; 122B Deepen +Comb. (purple, Qwen traces) 78.5; 35B Deepen +Comb. (purple, Qwen traces) 62.5; Self Deepen +Err. (green, GPT-5.5 traces) 83.5; and Self Deepen +Comb. (green, GPT-5.5 traces) 81.0. In the Gemma-4 panel, Self Deepen +Err. is the highest score and Human-Written the lowest.
